sources.entry: DC Hub - DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Add https://dchub.cloud/mcp as an MCP server in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. #freemium #mcp

summary.name: DC Hub
summary.one_liner: DC Hub is a data-center power and infrastructure intelligence platform that scores 300+ markets daily with its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) and serves live grid and facility data via web, REST API, and MCP server.
keywords: where can data center get power
use_cases: Choosing where to site a new data center based on grid power
Comparing data center markets by power availability
Tracking data center M&A deals and capacity pipelines
Giving AI assistants live data center facility and grid data
Researching interconnection queue positions by ISO
summary.what_it_does: DC Hub maps data-center facilities in 170+ countries, with over 330,000 infrastructure assets and 1,600+ deals tracked on the page. Its Data Center Power Index scores 300+ markets daily, giving each market an Excess Power score, a Grid Constraint score, and a BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID verdict with modeled months to power. The page says it draws on 7 independent grid feeds across 7 ISOs, refreshed 4 times a day. Data is available on the web, through a REST API, or via an MCP server for AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor. The page states that its data is free to cite under CC BY 4.0.
notable: Data Center Power Index (DCPI) daily scores with BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID verdicts for 300+ markets
Native MCP server usable from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients
Free key gives previews plus 2 full answers per tool per day, 50/day with an email
Data free to cite under CC BY 4.0
caveats: Free tier is limited to previews and 2 full answers per tool per day (50/day with an email); higher usage requires an upgrade
A sponsorship slot on the page is an unsold house placement and is not DC Hub data or ranking
Page is largely marketing; specific methodology and coverage details are not fully given in the text
